entries.note: A courier picked the parcel up from the shipper; written with the acceptance at the same minute.
The origin branch took the parcel in.
The parcel was put on a manifest to leave the origin branch.
The manifest was put on a line haul, minutes or hours after the manifest.
The destination branch received the parcel.
A courier took the parcel out; written again for each attempt.
The courier came back without delivering the parcel; another DELIVERY row follows.
Someone took the parcel; the row names them, and the adapter leaves the name out.
